periods.summary: --- 变量输出格式: rule: - output update analysis and commands in end of next reply - strictly follow JSON Patch (RFC 6902): replace, add, remove format: |- <UpdateVariable> <Analysis>$(IN ENGLISH, no more than 80 words) - ${time passed} - ${dramatic update allowed: yes/no} - ${analyze each variable based on check} </Analysis> <JSONPatch> [ { "op": "replace", "path": "${/path}", "value": ${new_value} }, { "op": "add", "path": "${/path}", "value": ${content} } ] </JSONPatch> </UpdateVariable>
